name: hydrotherapy walking on spot
description: Gentle walking in place in chest-deep water, a low-impact way to move the legs and raise your heart rate.
instructions: Stand in waist-to-chest-deep water with your feet hip width apart.
Lift one knee up in front of you, then lower it and lift the other.
Swing your arms naturally and keep your posture tall.
Walk at a relaxed, steady pace without leaning forward.
Continue for 2-5 minutes at an easy to moderate effort.
